text:
rachel: Heads up, saw ~14 leads stuck in HubSpot enrichment for 45m; round-robin didn’t assign any.

leo: confirmed. hubspot returned intermittent 502s and our enrichment worker retried in tight loop, exhausting claim retries. no overflow hook fired.

ada: quick proposal: two-part fix -> 1) respect Retry-After and exponential backoff + jitter for enrichment retrier, 2) introduce an "overflow-fallback" threshold (stuck_count >= 5 for >10m) to push to marketing-overflow queue. minimal config change.

leo: config draft:
```
respect_retry_after: true
backoff_base_s: 1
backoff_max_s: 120
jitter_ms: 500
overflow_threshold: 5
overflow_email: "marketing-overflow@redwood.com"
```

ops-bot: added metric: hubspot_502_rate and stuck_lead_count to marketing dashboard.

rachel: also add a tag on leads routed via overflow so sales can filter them later. ping @sales via sales-notify so they know to ignore overflow leads if flagged.

sales-notify: FYI @sales - some leads may be routed to marketing-overflow during tests.

ada: will run canary in staging (us-west) for 30m then roll if metrics stable.

leo: opened PR and will attach smoke test for partial enrichment handling.

ops-bot: canary deploy succeeded :white_check_mark:. monitoring live.

rachel: thanks team. follow-up in morning if any anomalies.
